friction: operating_points entries for 'ac|propulsion|propeller|diameter' and 'ac|propulsion|engine|rating' with a units tag failed at materialize ('canonical units are unknown'); with bare values the run succeeded but the overrides were silently ignored (engine stayed 750 hp, diameter 2.28 m).
components[].config.aircraft_data given together with aircraft_template (a partial override dict) was silently ignored.

Top-level initial_values on 'ac|...' aircraft-data outputs (e.g. MTOW, engine rating) were silently ignored; they only worked on non-aircraft-data paths like 'climb.OEW.structural_fudge'. Workaround: set 'ac|...' values through design_variables[].initial.
'ac|weights|structural_fudge' does not exist in this model ('Output not found for design variable'); the hybrid weight factor lives at 'climb.OEW.structural_fudge' and was set via initial_values.
Propeller diameter was pinned at 2.2 m using a design variable with lower == upper == 2.2, since no direct override worked.
validate_plan and plan_add_dv accept unknown pipe/dotted variable names without checking them; typos only surface at run time or never.
run_plan overrides only accept plan-schema keys, so they cannot set model inputs.

Without design-variable scaling (ref), SLSQP reported 'converged' at poor local points (DOC 0.535, 0.541, 0.449 $/nmi); adding ref scaling reached 0.26607 from both a battery-heavy and a fuel-heavy start.
With recording_level=minimal the 'Optimizer recorded 1 driver iterations' warning fires even when the optimizer moved a lot, so the warning is misleading.
get_results with summary=true, or with vector variables on a driver-level recording, overflowed the response size limit; had to request scalar variables only.
run_plan inputs_hash seems to depend on the plan path rather than its content (identical hash for different plan contents at the same path).

Could not verify through the tools that the built-in doc_per_nmi cost model uses exactly the specified coefficients (fuel $2.50/gal, electricity $36/MWh on 90% of battery energy, airframe $277/kg, engine $775/shp, motor and generator $100/shp, 1.1 OEM premium, 5 flights/day for 15 years, battery $50/kg over 1500 cycles); used it as provided.
record_conclusion returned verdict 'partial' because the plan had no requirements block.
